final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT riskandmargin.ordervault, orders.timespan, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin JOIN orders ON riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault GROUP BY riskandmargin.ordervault, orders.timespan), step2 AS (SELECT timespan, SUM(cnt) as sum_cnt FROM step1 GROUP BY timespan), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(sum_cnt) as total_sum FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.timespan, step2.sum_cnt, CAST(step2.sum_cnt AS REAL) / step3.total_sum as proportion FROM step2, step3), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step4) SELECT step4.timespan, step4.sum_cnt, step4.proportion, step4.proportion - step5.avg_proportion as deviation FROM step4, step5
